text:
(ESA 2023) What are the missing question words in the inquiry made by Sergeant Brooks?

Sergeant Brooks: Can you tell me _____ you last saw Private Johnson?
Corporal Diaz: I last saw him in Colonel Grant’s office.
Sergeant Brooks: _____ did you see him exactly?
Corporal Diaz: Five minutes before lunch break.
Sergeant Brooks: And _____ was he doing there?
Corporal Diaz: He was repairing the colonel’s computer.
Sergeant Brooks: _____ was he with?
Corporal Diaz: Nobody. He was alone.
Sergeant Brooks: _____ did you go to the Colonel’s Office?
Corporal Diaz: Because I had to take documents to Colonel Grant before he left for lunch.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(D) Certa. Como os comentário a seguir comprovam:

1) Can you tell me where you last saw Private Johnson?

Resposta: I last saw him in Colonel Grant’s office.

Tradução: Eu o vi pela última vez no escritório do Coronel Grant.

Justificativa: Usa-se "where" porque a pergunta exige uma resposta que indique lugar.

2) When did you see him exactly?

Resposta: Five minutes before lunch break.

Tradução: Cinco minutos antes do intervalo para o almoço.

Justificativa: Usa-se "when" porque a pergunta pede uma informação de tempo.

3) And what was he doing there?

Resposta: He was repairing the colonel’s computer.

Tradução: Ele estava consertando o computador do coronel.

Justificativa: Usa-se "what" porque a pergunta busca saber qual atividade estava sendo realizada.

4) Who was he with?

Resposta: Nobody. He was alone.

Tradução: Ninguém. Ele estava sozinho.

Justificativa: Usa-se "who" porque a pergunta quer saber com quem o sujeito estava.

5) Why did you go to the Colonel’s Office?

Resposta: Because I had to take documents to Colonel Grant before he left for lunch.

Tradução: Porque eu precisava levar documentos ao Coronel Grant antes que ele saísse para o almoço.

Justificativa: Usa-se "why" porque a pergunta busca a razão ou motivo da ação.
